name: Bash script for voice transcription to clipboard

mentions.name: Bash script for voice transcription to clipboard
mentions.description: A self-stitched bash script for Linux that transcribes voice and copies the transcription to the clipboard, currently using the Parakeet TDT 0.6B model, serving as a stand-in for WisprFlow on the author's Manjaro KDE daily driver.
mentions.problem: The author liked WisprFlow on macOS but their daily driver is Manjaro KDE, where it isn't available.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have stitched together a bash script that copies the transcription (right now I am using the Parakeet TDT 0.6B) to my clipboard.

evidence.value: I have stitched together a bash script that copies the transcription (right now I am using the Parakeet TDT 0.6B) to my clipboard.
